The Best Restaurant in Nha Trang
Oct 2016 • Solo
The major cities of Vietnam have seen an explosion in the number of new restaurants in recent years, still when I am in Nha Trang, the Pavilion Restaurant is my restaurant of choice. It is an attractive and very relaxing restaurant, especially when dining outside facing the sea.

The service is excellent and the menu is a nice reflection of both Vietnamese dishes and International dishes. The challenge is that the menu is fairly extensive and everything looks good. I tend to start with crispy Vietnamese spring rolls, followed by a Caesar salad and then an entrée of fish. Their sea bass is exceptional, but then again, Nha Trang is known for their seafood. A side of stir-fried Morning Glory with garlic makes this a delicious meal. This is a very good restaurant.

Great atmosphere and service, entree was food but the mains were very disappointing.
Sep 2012 • Couples
We were not guests at the resort so we rang ahead and told them we were staying somewhere else and booked a table for two. They were pleasant and said it was fine. When we arrived, they knew straight away it was us and greeted us by our booking name.

Waitress was attentive and being a quite night they made sure we were satisfied with everything. Entree we had a sesame prawn which looked excellent and tasted great! My husband had the pork belly salad and that was very good, large serving.

Main we had the steak which was meant to be grilled and were a little surprised when we asked about the thickness of it, the waitress said it was 1cm thick. We ignored that response and ordered anyway. The steak was in fact 1cm thick only, was pan fried, not grilled and sinewy and not very tasty. I ordered scallops with fresh green tea rice noodles, Bok Choy and soy. The scallops were tiny, noodles were sloppy and NOT green tea, they were just plain, tasteless stir fried rice noodles with overlooked bok Choy.

Dessert however was amazing, we shared a chocolate moleleux with raspberry sorbet which was a Choc cake with hot chocolate surface oozing from the middle. The sorbet was superb and vanilla sauce very tasty.

Overall we would give this a 3.5 out of 5.

Good Food Great Location
Feb 2011
The Ana Pavilion resturant is located at the Mandara Resort, beachside in Nha Trang. It is a fairly exclusive resort and like wise the prices reflect this. You wont be going for the bargains, on the upside the food is excellent, very tasty local and seafood dishes. You can opt for the buffet at a set price and eat your heart out , or order Ala' Carte. 
A chef / Cook shall barbeque your selection and serve it to you and there are plenty of choices
It is located on the beach, backing onto the resorts resturant, there were live musicians playing soft music that really made for a romantic atmosphere while watching the waves roll in.
The wine list is expensive, even by western standards, you can opt for house wine by the glass and I suggest you do this for your first drink until you get a chance to review the prices, but lets be honest, the place does not pretend to be a bargain hunter paradise, your paying for quality here.
